description: Presidential Secretariat - The Maritime Zones Law No. 22 of 1976 of the National State Assembly
reasoning: This gazette content is a presidential proclamation under the Maritime Zones Law, No. 22 of 1976, which establishes legal boundaries and coordinates for Sri Lanka's maritime zones. It amends previous legal declarations and contains detailed geographical coordinates and technical specifications that form part of Sri Lanka's legal and regulatory framework. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it deals with statutory instruments and legal declarations rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
